QUOTE: "**\"Always Allow/Deny\"** writes through `PermissionPersister::save_permission`, which inserts `- <pattern>` under `permissions.allow` or `permissions.deny` in the project YAML."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes persisting to the "project YAML" via PermissionPersister but never names config.local.yaml, and it doesn't contrast persistence with the in-memory add_permission call.
